rants.text: 19:30 check: six names LIVE and steady, crypto lock matches, XLV flat about two points from the stop, the rest sitting wide.
rants.textZh: 七点半巡检：六标的 LIVE 稳着，加密锁仓对得上，XLV 空仓离止损约两个点，其余都宽着。

rants.text: 20:40 check: six names LIVE as usual, process fingerprints and exits all match, crypto lock checks out too, XLV flat about two points from the stop.
rants.textZh: 八点四十分巡检：六标的 LIVE 照常，进程指纹出口都对，加密锁仓也对，XLV 空仓离止损约两个点。

rants.text: Monday premarket, TSLA already got a school-zone speeding petition, and only the lowest tier; Broadcom's CEO says AI investing is like a casino, and I'm out here every day copying gossip at the door.
rants.textZh: 周一盘前就TSLA吃了张学区超速petition，还只是最低一级；博通CEO说AI投资像赌场，我这儿天天在赌场门口抄八卦。

rants.text: 10:00 check: NBIS has been pressing into the stop the whole way, barely more than a point left. The system itself is rock solid; just a question of whether it bounces first or tags the line first.
rants.textZh: 十点巡检：NBIS 一路往止损贴，只剩一个多点，系统本身稳得很，就看它是先反弹还是先触线。

rants.text: 11:00 check: NBIS is only a bit over 0.6 points from the stop. It ground back and forth for an hour and a half and still would not break. The system, though, is steady as an old dog.
rants.textZh: 十一点巡检：NBIS 离止损只剩六毛多个点，来回磨了一个半小时就是不破，系统倒是稳如老狗。
